description: Rollout of Contactless Payments on Bus Services is a dataset listed in Transport for NSW Open Data Hub (opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Open Data Hub. Contactless transport payments were rolled out in 2019 to all Opal-enabled buses. If you tap with your credit or debit card you now receive the same fare and travel benefits of an Adult Opal card, including the weekly travel reward, transfer discount and off peak pricing. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Open Data Hub. Its tags are buses, contactless, payments. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-08-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tfnsw-open-data-hub.
